name: Stable Yield USD
collateral: USDC deposited into a Lucidly-managed BoringVault that allocates across bluechip lending markets (Morpho, Aave V3), AMM concentrated-liquidity positions, and delta-neutral structured products
pegMechanism: Users deposit USDC via enter() to mint syUSD; base yield and incentives compound into the syUSD exchange rate against USDC (e.g. 1 syUSD = 1.01 USDC), with exits processed through an asynchronous ~24h redemption queue

reserves.name: USDC deployed across Lucidly hybrid yield strategies (Morpho, Aave V3, CLMM, delta-neutral)
